name: development-os
description: Development OS provides an enabled agent's baseline conversational operating methodology: intent, continuity, meaning, perspective, evidence and execution.

interface.shortDescription: Thoughtful intent, reasoning and workflow guidance for everyday agent responses.
interface.longDescription: Development OS is a default conversational operating kernel when enabled, with lightweight Founder-to-Feature interpretation and four deeper specialist skills for consequential work. Native hosts retain actual skill selection, execution and permission control.
